completion_criteria: A user can add, edit, find and review a term, close DPH, reopen the same project and retain the exact current record and history.

Source-linked terms retain evidence and become review-needed when affected source changes.
Meaningful persistence, revision, review, scope, search and export regressions pass; the application builds and the native workflow is checked.
Run/test directions and guides describe the actual shipped controls; update the two requirement records with evidence, commit and push both remotes.
recommended_next_step.dependencies: Uses existing knowledge versioning, source links, named review, search and publication foundations. No external AI service, production database connection or additional planning file is needed. Real business definitions are entered by contributors; regression fixtures verify the software without requiring those definitions.
recommended_next_step.boundary: Do not fold interviews, general business-process modeling, natural-language AI answering or report/schema analysis into this implementation batch.
